records.narrow_fact: A local non-authorizing evaluator contract function exposes request JSON Schema.
records.unsupported_extension: A self-contained schema function does not prove live capability discovery across all external clients.

records.narrow_fact: The evaluator builder delegates manifest construction with the governance capability selected.
records.unsupported_extension: This construction is not independent proof of StegCore admission or execution.

records.narrow_fact: Optional evaluator declarations are copied into an extension only after object-type validation.
records.unsupported_extension: Injected metadata remains preregistration information and does not become governance authority.

records.narrow_fact: An optional posture request is validated then appended as request context.

records.narrow_fact: The builder rejects a mismatch when both manifest data_class and security-posture request data_class exist.

records.narrow_fact: The authority-bound builder invokes the supplied canonical resolver and binds returned facts.
records.unsupported_extension: Role labels, standalone SDK logic and source code do not independently authenticate actual external authority.

records.narrow_fact: The explicit authority-boundary constant denies SDK governance-resolution authority.

records.narrow_fact: Human-readable manifest guidance lists profile and provenance fields.
records.unsupported_extension: Guidance describes an illustrative section; strict required fields are governed by the actual validator and JSON schema.

records.narrow_fact: The documented subject section lists payload or commitment, candidate and stated intent.
records.unsupported_extension: Conditional governance candidate requirements vary by selected processor, not a universal always-required rule.

records.narrow_fact: The third documented section lists integrity hash and optional attestation context.

records.narrow_fact: The fourth guidance section says trajectory is generated from an actual governed run.
